text: 2026-08-03 phase-provenance slice: added checked EventPhase and MultiphaseEventTerm runtime lowering. A phase now retains phase id, parent EventIds, source-row indices, onset/duration/block provenance, and shared factor/modulator Event values; misaligned or duplicate source rows are typed DesignError failures. EventTerm carries phaseId/eventProvenance, EventModel structural origins now emit phase identity, and DesignAudit/fingerprint retain event provenance. Added design.multiphase-provenance.v1 public scenario plus EventPhaseSuite; focused JVM+JS scenario 1/1 and full designJVM/test 193/193, designJS/test 193/193; manifest validator passes 26 entries and git diff --check clean. This is deliberately a provenance/API slice, not the full DMS 50-column, independent continuous-time, mixed-HRF, or censor/AR acceptance workflow; P3.1 and P3.2 remain open for those criteria.
